URL: https://www.zotac.com/product/graphics_card/zotac-gaming-geforce-rtx-3070-twin-edge-lhr

ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 3070 Twin Edge LHR | ZOTAC

ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 3070 Twin Edge LHR

ZT-A30700E-10PLHR

Get Amplified with the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX™ 30 Series based on the NVIDIA Ampere architecture. Built with enhanced RT Cores and Tensor Cores, new streaming multiprocessors, and high-speed GDDR6 memory, the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 3070 Twin Edge LHR gives rise to amplified gaming with high fidelity.

Features: - 2nd Gen Ray Tracing Cores - 3rd Gen Tensor Cores - White LED Lighting - IceStorm 2.0 Advanced Cooling - Active Fan Control with FREEZE Fan Stop - Metal Wraparound Backplate - FireStorm Utility (Download HERE) - VR Ready - LHR 25 MH/s ETH hash rate (est.)
